<|det|>text [87, 228, 910, 304]<|/det|>VII Finance: When liquidation happens, the Euler vault associated with borrowed token, asks EVC to manipulate the injected _msgSender() to be violator and call transfer function with to = liquidator and amount = whatever liquidator deserves for taking on violator's debt. As far as the wrapper is concerned, zero value liquidation is just a zero value transfer. The wrapper allows it the same way any other Euler vault that follow ERC20 standard allows for zero value transfers. We don't see a need for preventing the zero value transfers.
